source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1) cd <Diag Package Directory> 2) Run Partner Manufacturing Diagnostics: - Mfg : - Run on DUT ./partnerdiag --mfg --run_spec=spec_cx8aas_board_partner_mfg.json 3) PASS/FAIL/RETEST will be displayed when partnerdiag finishes execution. 4) Run ./partnerdiag --help for more details on options Useful Options -------------- 1) --skip_tests=<virtual_id>,<virtual_id> --> Skips the specified list of tests. 2) --test=<virtual_id>,<virtual_id> --> Tests the specified list of tests. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
